diffs.evidence: The two readings describe different quantities. The second reading's 0.01/offset 0 is the compensated int32 output: datasheet sec. 4.2.3/8.2 'Returns temperature in DegC, resolution is 0.01 DegC. Output value of "5123" equals 51.23 DegC.' The model's sim measure maps the raw 20-bit adc_T register (0xFA, shift 4) to degC. The chip does not output compensated values; the driver computes them with BME280_compensate_T_double (sec. 8.1): T = (adc_T/16384 - T1/1024)*T2/5120 + (T3 term). With the sim's calibration dig_T1=27504 (0x88/0x89), dig_T2=26435, dig_T3=0, that gives scale 26435/83886080 = 0.00031513 and offset -27504*26435/5242880 = -138.677, exactly the model's values. Checked numerically: running the driver's datasheet formulas on the sim's encoded adc_T returns -40.0, 0.0, 22.0, 31.4 and 85.0 degC exactly.

diffs.diff: pressure_Pa: datasheet reading gives 0.00390625 per count, the part's model has 0.0003151, -0.001666, 0.005646
diffs.evidence: 0.00390625 = 1/256 is the Q24.8 format of the compensated int64 output: 'Returns pressure in Pa as unsigned 32 bit integer in Q24.8 format ... Output value of "24674867" represents 24674867/256 = 96386.2 Pa'. The model's pressure measure (-0.001666 hPa per count) maps the raw 20-bit adc_P (0xF7, shift 4) through BME280_compensate_P_double (sec. 8.1). The scale is negative because the formula starts p = 1048576 - adc_P. It uses the sim's calibration dig_P1=36477, dig_P4=2855, dig_P7=15500, dig_P8=-14600, with P2/P3/P5/P6/P9=0, so the map is linear. Checked numerically: the driver decodes the sim's adc_P to 300.0, 700.0, 950.0, 1013.25 and 1100.0 hPa exactly. (The diff line also lists 0.0003151 and 0.005646, which are the temperature and humidity measure scales, not pressure.)

diffs.diff: humidity_pctRH: datasheet reading gives 0.0009765625 per count, the part's model has 0.0003151, -0.001666, 0.005646
diffs.evidence: 0.0009765625 = 1/1024 is the Q22.10 format of the compensated int32 output: 'Returns humidity in %RH as unsigned 32 bit integer in Q22.10 format ... Output value of "47445" represents 47445/1024 = 46.333 %RH'. The model's humidity measure (0.005646 %RH per count, offset -113.1) maps the raw 16-bit adc_H (0xFD) through bme280_compensate_H_double (sec. 8.1). It uses the sim's calibration dig_H2=370, dig_H4=313, dig_H1=dig_H3=dig_H5=dig_H6=0 and t_fine from the temperature step. Checked numerically: the driver decodes the sim's adc_H to 0.0, 10.0, 50.0, 65.0 and 100.0 %RH (within 0.002). (The diff line also lists 0.0003151 and -0.001666, which are the temperature and pressure measure scales.)
